candidates.change_summary: Change the returned value from true to false at the end of transfer.
Return the success flag of the last low-level call instead of always true.
Insert a conditional that returns false immediately if the loop has more than one recipient, otherwise keep original behavior.

Change the required selector to call transferFrom(address,address,uint256) -> transferFrom(address,address,uint256) with different argument order by swapping _tos[i] and from in the abi.encodeWithSelector call, which changes which addresses are passed to the external call and thus can alter observable effects.
Require that the call to caddress may fail without reverting transfer by removing the require(_s) so failed external calls don't revert the whole transfer, changing observable outcome.
Change the loop to iterate from end to start (reverse order), altering the sequence of external transferFrom calls and thus observable state transitions.
